description: Change the 3D view of a composition's Composition panel (View menu): switch to the active camera, front, left, top, back, right, bottom or a custom view (View > Switch 3D View) or the last view, reset the view, look at the selected or all layers, or create a camera from the current view. Opens the composition in the viewer first

action.description: Instead of a view: View > Reset 3D View, Look at Selected Layers, Look at All Layers, or Create Camera from 3D View

comp.description: Which composition. Give its item id (from list_items) or name; omit for the active composition

view.description: The view to switch to (View > Switch 3D View; last = View > Switch to Last 3D View)

name: set_3d_view
title: Set 3d View
